because: d-0dffb37d dropped the server fetch because it was 'the losing fetcher' AND was the last reason to keep putBlob, the sniffer and a three-armed union. The first half only says it must not be the ONLY fetcher: a CORS-refusing CDN (assets.bonappetit.com sends no ACAO; verified by curl with an Origin header, 200 image/jpeg 534513 bytes) is unreachable from a tab, and hotlink protection is unreachable from a datacenter IP, so the failure sets are disjoint and browser-first/server-second wins on both. Re-using presignUpload keeps the bucket the enforcer of key/content-type/2MB and adds no second write door to blob-storage.ts; relaying to the browser would double the egress for the same trust model. Mime is sniffed again here, reversing that half of d-0dffb37d, because on this path the bytes DO pass through the server and the party declaring the type is a third-party host, not our own user. Bulk import stays excluded: 341 recipes x 2MB of server egress needs a different rate-limit design than one create-form photo.
